name: Sparse update semantics for source-bound catalogue delivery
donor: Transactional field updates: absence of a record is not deletion
target: Supplier feeds containing only changed rows and authorized columns
old_restriction: The native producer consumes complete snapshots with full canonical schema and target membership
adaptation: Construct a complete after-image from before+explicit delta, then reuse native patch/apply/rollback
authority: Existing rows and declared writable columns only; no insertion, deletion, external writes or payment
cost_scope: No model calls; timings recorded, full actual cost unknown
novelty: Known update semantics; designer-supplied mapping, not autonomous analogy discovery
successor_status: Reusable adapter exists; causal benefit to independent successor invention not tested
failure_conditions: Feed is a full replacement rather than a delta
retention: This is a portable evidence record, not a new registry or automatic production promotion
